kinds.d: Hand-held power saw with a rotating toothed disc, for straight cuts in timber and sheet.
Hand-held power saw with a short, vertically reciprocating blade, for curves and cut-outs.
Power saw with its blade on a pivoting arm over a table, for crosscuts and angled cuts.
Circular saw whose blade plunges from a sprung housing and that runs on a guide rail, for straight sheet cuts.
Hand-held power saw with a long blade driven back and forth in line with the body, for demolition and rough cuts.
Hand-held engine or electric saw with a large abrasive or diamond disc behind a guard, for concrete, stone and steel.
Hand-held machine with twin diamond discs that cuts parallel channels in masonry for cables and pipes.

notes: Restraint only. Dropped platform ranges (18V ONE+, 18V XR, M18 FUEL, FlexVolt 54V) and the KAPEX range (its model stays). Mitre saw trimmed 11 to 8 (dropped GCM 12 SDE, KAPEX KS 60 E, LS0815FL); sliding and compound are types. Cut-off saw and wall chaser joined from the old breakers shelf, kind-level.
